critical_finding: CLI and WASM spans operate in separate trace contexts (different trace_id each), breaking distributed tracing causality per chicago-tdd.md §3 (100% OTEL coverage mandate)

gaps.title: Trace Correlation Missing at WASM Boundary
gaps.root_cause: CLI and WASM span emitters independently generate trace_id via randomBytes(16). No parent-child correlation. Every WASM call starts new trace (separate from CLI command trace).

evidence.wasm_side: wasm4pm/src/lib.rs spans never receive parent trace_id
evidence.consequence: Jaeger UI shows disconnected traces; cannot correlate CLI decision → WASM execution → result

gaps.impact: Distributed tracing broken, root cause analysis impossible, compliance violation of chicago-tdd.md

requires.cli_change: Pass trace_id to WASM call, embed in JSON serialization
requires.wasm_change: Extract trace_id parameter, emit child spans under same trace
requires.test_validation: Verify WASM child spans have same trace_id as CLI parent

gaps.title: 368 Catch Blocks Without Span Emission
gaps.root_cause: Error handling at 4 categories: (1) optional validation (schema, attributes), (2) ETA estimation, (3) platform checks, (4) resource cleanup. All catch blocks are marked 'optional' or 'best-effort', making errors invisible.

evidence.pattern_3: Fallback chains in 15+ discovery commands with silent failures

gaps.span_type: All error categories: config validation, schema checks, estimation, cleanup
gaps.impact: Silent failures, FM-5 self-referential testing risk (code succeeds but no event proof), no observability for audit trails
missing_instrumentation: Trace of which fallback algorithms were tried on discovery failure

gaps.title: Early Error Returns Before Command Span Wrapper
gaps.root_cause: Validation happens BEFORE withSpan() wrapper activates: missing args, invalid flags, WASM unavailable, engine init timeout. No span wrapper exists yet, so errors exit with zero observability.

evidence.example: If user provides --algorithm=fake_algo, validation fails before withSpan activates

gaps.span_type: Pre-command spans (validation, WASM availability, engine init)
gaps.impact: Validation errors invisible, no proof in OTEL that validation occurred
gaps.solution: Wrap pre-command validation in dedicated spans before main command span

gaps.title: File I/O Error Spans Lack Context
gaps.root_cause: When XES/TOML/JSON files fail to parse or save, error message is captured but file path, operation type (read/write), and error classification (ENOENT, EACCES, parse_error) are missing from span attributes.

evidence.pattern: fs/promises calls wrapped minimally; error.message only, no error.code tracking

gaps.span_type: File I/O error spans with incomplete attributes
gaps.impact: Insufficient forensics for debugging file-related failures

gaps.title: Algorithm Performance Spans Missing Semantic Context
gaps.root_cause: Algorithm spans (wasm.discover_dfg, wasm.discover_genetic, etc.) emit duration and status but NO algorithm name or quality metrics. Cannot correlate 'which algorithm was slow' or 'algorithm quality by type'.
gaps.impact: Performance analysis fragmented; cannot group metrics by algorithm or correlate quality

gaps.title: WASM Cleanup/Teardown Operations Missing Observability
gaps.root_cause: Cleanup errors (delete_object failures, memory deallocation errors) are caught and swallowed in finally blocks without span emission. Best-effort operations lack proof of success/failure.

evidence.pattern: finally blocks with 'catch { }' swallowing resource cleanup errors

gaps.impact: Silent resource leaks, no proof cleanup attempted
gaps.solution: Emit cleanup spans with success/failure status even for best-effort operations

chicago_tdd_violations: chicago-tdd.md §3: '100% of operations must emit OTEL spans' — only 7.6% of error paths have observability
chicago-tdd.md Doctrine: 'If the code says it worked but the event log cannot prove a lawful process happened, then it did not work' — 340 catch blocks have no event proof
critical-constraints.md §2: 'service.name + status mandatory' — not all error spans include required fields

critical_path.order: OTEL-1 (trace correlation) → OTEL-2 (error spans) → OTEL-3 (early validation) → OTEL-4/5/6 (polish)
critical_path.blocking: OTEL-1 blocks end-to-end distributed tracing; must be fixed before higher-level correlation possible

summary: wasm4pm has 7.6% OTEL catch block coverage (28/368). Three critical gaps: (1) CLI-WASM trace correlation broken (separate trace_ids), (2) 340 silent error paths without span emission, (3) Pre-command validation happens outside span context. Fix order: implement trace_id propagation (OTEL-1), add error span emission to hot-path catch blocks (OTEL-2), wrap pre-validation in spans (OTEL-3). Estimated 13 hours to close all gaps. Violations of chicago-tdd.md §3 (100% OTEL coverage) and critical-constraints.md §2 (required attributes) are material.
